records.subject: Welcome aboard, Union Labs
records.body:
Hi Leo,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *Union Labs* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Project created day 1 (2026-07-05) then nothing for ~7 days; no invites, no tickets, and no reply to three outreach emails (email:fc170636, email:43c559f0, email:98991330). Silence plus stalled usage with 8 days left suggests low unaided odds, though Pro plan and early project give some chance.

draft.subject: One next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Leo,

You've got your first project set up, which is the main thing -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The usual next step from there is bringing in a teammate or two: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through your setup with you and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Chidi
